x-ray.translation:
a. X射线的
vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光
x-ray.definition:
v. examine by taking x-rays
v. take an x-ray of something or somebody

xenon.definition: n. a colorless odorless inert gaseous element occurring in the earth's atmosphere in trace amounts

xenophobe.translation:
n. 畏惧和憎恨外国人的人
[法] 仇视外国人, 恐惧外国人者, 害怕生人者

xenophobia.translation:
n. 无端畏惧和憎恨外国人/陌生人, 对外国人的畏惧和憎恨
[医] 生客恐怖
xenophobia.definition: n. a fear of foreigners or strangers

xenophobic.translation:
a. 畏惧和憎恨外国人的
[法] 仇外的, 恐惧外国人的
xenophobic.definition: s. suffering from xenophobia; having abnormal fear or hatred of the strange or foreign

xeric.translation: a. 干旱的, 环境干燥的, 耐旱的, 沙漠般的

xerophyte.definition: n plant adapted for life with a limited supply of water; compare hydrophyte and mesophyte

xerox.definition:
n. a copy made by a xerographic printer
n. a duplicator (trade mark Xerox) that copies graphic matter by the action of light on an electrically charged photoconductive insulating surface in which the latent image is developed with a resinous powder

xeroxed.translation: v. 复印, 影印( Xerox的过去式和过去分词 )

xylem.translation:
n. 木质部
[医] 木质部(植物纤维束的)
xylem.definition: n. the woody part of plants: the supporting and water-conducting tissue, consisting primarily of tracheids and vessels

xylene.translation:
n. 二甲苯
[化] 二甲苯
xylene.definition: n. a colorless flammable volatile liquid hydrocarbon used as a solvent

xylophone.definition: n a percussion instrument with wooden bars tuned to produce a chromatic scale and with resonators; played with small mallets
